Maya (PM): Heads-up — Galileo Bank (pilot) asked for on‑prem private deployment in their GCP colo. They want data residency + HSM, pilot target: 8 weeks. Sales flagged as high priority.
Jules (Sales): +1. They've signed NDA and can give network diagrams next week. Budgeted for reserved capacity.
Anita (Eng-Platform): Need to triage: VPC peering vs. private interconnect? HSM model? Airgap? K8s version? Any compliance docs from customer?
Maya (PM): They require HSM-backed keywrap (FIPS) and SCIF-level airgap windows for cert installs. Can accept a managed KMS via customer HSM proxy.
Zach (SRE): For timeline, we need estimate on three tracks: infra prep, runtime onboarding, security review. Rough ETA: infra 2‑3w, runtime + model ops 2w, security/compliance 1–2w. So 6–7w optimistic.
Kai (Solutions): Do they need model training? or just inference? If inference only we can reuse hosted model artifacts.
Jules (Sales): Inference only. They'll want Redwood runtime on their private network, pin to model v1.2 and strict logging off by default.
Anita (Eng-Platform): Blockers: HSM procurement & network approvals. Also need access window for install — customer wants weekend maintenance.
Maya (PM): OK. Need a short checklist to send to customer and an internal backlog ticket with priority/acceptance criteria.
Anita (Eng-Platform): Draft checklist:
```
- Network: private interconnect OR VPC peering + static routes
- Firewall: allow egress to control plane IPs (list)
- Storage: NFS or S3‑compatible endpoint
- HSM: model (e.g., Thales/Luna), certs, admin contacts
- OS/base: Ubuntu 22.04, kernel reqs
- K8s: 1.25+ (or we'll use k3s fallback)
- Service account + KMS policy
- Maintenance window preference
- Audit/log shipping (optional)
```
Maya (PM): Nice. Add acceptance criteria: smoke inference test <100ms p50 on pinned model, keys rotate via HSM, end‑to‑end audit trail for requests.
Zach (SRE): We'll also need GPU spec. Recommend A10G or T4 for pilot cost. Note: quantized float16 may be required if GPUs limited.
Kai (Solutions): I'll request network diagram and HSM cert exports from customer. Can we make the install non-root? They prefer operators only.
Anita (Eng-Platform): Yes — we can provide operator-mode install scripts. Also flag: if customer is airgapped we need an offline installer tar and SHA256.
Maya (PM): OK next steps — Kai to collect docs (network, HSM, maintenance window) by EOW. Anita/Zach estimate infra runbook + rough cost by next Wed. I'll create the backlog ticket and attach checklist.
Jules (Sales): Customer is expecting go/no-go within 10 business days. I'll push for docs early.
deploy-bot: Deployment window requested: 2025-05-17 02:00 UTC (tentative).
Maya (PM): Thanks — will update ticket when runbook is ready. :thumbsup:
